Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class LmRequest

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.LmRequest
public final class LmRequest extends Object
Immutable request payload for language-model completions in the TA system.

LmRequest unifies chat-style multi-turn input (LmMessage list) and simple prompt-style input (getSystemPrompt() + getUserPrompt()) behind one type consumed by LmClient. Build instances with builder().

If getMessages() is non-empty, HttpLmClient serialises the message list directly. If empty, it synthesises system and user messages from the prompt fields.

The optional getFeatureName() (AiFeatureNames) routes MockLmClient to feature-specific deterministic handlers and supports logging in AI services.

      public String getModel()
      Returns the per-request model override, if any.
